fact: Media Proclamation No. 1238/2021 requires media to broadcast programs with content specially adapted for persons with disabilities (Article 55(n)), according to the article.

An academic study in IJCSNS (June 2020) tested 38 Ethiopian federal government homepages against WCAG 2.0 AA with four automated tools and found none met the minimum accessibility conformance, with 3 sites having over 100 errors in the TAW results.
